script: セイバールート十一日目-14
title: セイバールート十一日目-14

pages.ja:
風が解けていく。
セイバーの手には黄金の剣が見え始める。
使うなと。
決して使わないでほしいと言った、あの剣。
pages.jaRuby:

使うなと。
決して使わないでほしいと言った、あの剣。
pages.en:
The wind begins to unravel.

A golden sword takes shape in Saber's hands.

—Do not use it.

That sword I begged her never, ever to use.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The wind unravels.
I start to see the golden sword in Saber’s hands.
The one that must not be used.
The sword I told her not to use under any circumstances.

pages.ja:
「
」
切れた。
それで、かろうじて自分をつなぎ止めていた最後の線がぶち切れた。
「使うなセイバー
！！！！！」
左手が焼ける。
令呪が一つ消えていく。

令呪が一つ消えていく。
pages.en:
“————”

Something snaps.

And with it, the last thread barely holding me together breaks.

“Do not use it, Saber—!!!!!”

My left hand burns.

One of my Command Spells disappears.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I snap.
It makes the last rope holding me snap.
“Don’t use it, Saber!!!!!!”
My left hand is burning.
One of the Command Spells disappears.

pages.ja:
「な
どうして、もうこれしかないではないですか、シロウ……！」
pages.jaRuby:
「な
どうして、もうこれしかないではないですか、シロウ……！」
pages.en: “Wh—why? There is nothing else left to us, Shirou…!”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Whawhy? This is the only way now, Shirou…!”

pages.ja:
知らない。
そんな事は知らない。
俺に判るのは、それを使えばおまえが消えるという事だけだ。
pages.jaRuby:

I do not care.

I do not care about any of that.

All I know is that if you use it, you will disappear.

I don’t know.
I don’t know anything about that.
All I know is that you’ll disappear if you use that.
I won’t allow that.
And I can’t forgive myself for not being able to let her use her sword freely and for not being able to save Tohsaka myself.

pages.ja:
……剣を解放しただけでそれなんだ。
今のおまえにその剣は使えない。
だから待ってろ。
おまえがその剣を使えないのなら、俺が、使える剣を用意してやる
！

…Merely releasing the sword has already done that to you.

You cannot wield it as you are now.

So wait there.

If you cannot use that sword, then I will make you one you can—!

Saber falls to her knees.
…Just releasing the sword gets her like that.
You can’t use that sword in your condition.
So wait.
If you can’t use that sword, I’ll make one that you can use!

pages.ja:
現実で敵わない相手なら、想像の中で勝て。
自身が勝てないのなら、勝てるモノを幻想しろ。
pages.jaRuby:
現実で敵わない相手なら、想像の中で勝て。
自身が勝てないのなら、勝てるモノを幻想しろ。
pages.en:
—If an enemy is beyond you in reality, defeat him in your imagination.

If you cannot win, imagine something that can.
pages.mirrorMoon:
If it is an opponent you cannot match in real life, beat it in your imagination.
If you cannot beat it yourself, imagine something that you could beat it with.

pages.ja:
言われてみれば、そんなのは当たり前だ。
俺に出来るのはそんなことしかない。
ならば作れ。
誰にも負けないモノを作れ、常に最強のイメージを想え、誰をも騙し、自分さえ騙しうる、最強の模造品を想像しろ。
pages.jaRuby:
言われてみれば、そんなのは当たり前だ。
俺に出来るのはそんなことしかない。
ならば作れ。
誰にも負けないモノを作れ、常に最強のイメージを想え、誰をも騙し、自分さえ騙しうる、最強の模造品を想像しろ。
pages.en:
Put that way, it is obvious.

This is the only thing I can do.

Then make it.

Make something that can lose to no one. Hold always the image of the strongest thing there is. Imagine the supreme counterfeit—one that can deceive anyone, even yourself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
With that said, it’s obvious.
That’s the only thing I can do.
So make it.
Make something that will not lose to anything. Always imagine the strongest. Imagine the best imitation that will deceive everybody, even yourself.

pages.ja:
難しい筈はない。
不可能な事でもない。
もとよりこの身は、
ただそれだけに特化した魔術回路
！
「ぉ
」
跳ね起きる。
全身は発火したように熱く、左手はそれこそ紅蓮。
pages.jaRuby:
難しい筈はない。

「ぉ
」

pages.en:
It should not be difficult.

Nor is it impossible.

From the beginning, this body has been—

Nothing but Magic Circuits made for that single purpose—!

“Oh—”

I spring to my feet.

My whole body burns as though it has caught fire, and my left hand is crimson flame itself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It is not difficult at all.
It is not impossible.
From the beginning, this body was…
…A Magic Circuit specialized for this purpose alone!!
“Ah”
I spring up.
My whole body is burning and my left hand feels like it’s on fire.

pages.ja:
「な
あの剣は、私の……！？」
呆然としたセイバーの声。
その視線の先には、この手が握るあり得ないモノ。
pages.jaRuby:
「な
あの剣は、私の……！？」
呆然としたセイバーの声。
その視線の先には、この手が握るあり得ないモノ。
pages.en:
“Wh—that sword is mine…!?”

Saber's voice is stunned.

Her gaze rests on the impossible thing gripped in my hand.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Wha? That sword is my…!?”
Saber’s voice is filled with blank amazement.
She is staring at what I’m holding, which should not exist here.

pages.ja:
「お
」
俺ではなく、剣そのものに意思があるのか。
「オオオオオオオオオォオ
！」
黄金の剣は吸い込まれるように、止まる事なく、巨人の腕を切断した。
pages.jaRuby:
「お
」
俺ではなく、剣そのものに意思があるのか。
「オオオオオオオオオォオ
！」
黄金の剣は吸い込まれるように、止まる事なく、巨人の腕を切断した。
pages.en:
“Oh—”

Is it not I, but the sword itself, that possesses a will?

“OOOOOOOOOHHHH—!”

The golden blade seems drawn into the giant's flesh. Without stopping, it shears through his arm.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah”
Does the sword have a will of its own?
“AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!”
The golden sword does not stop and, as if pulled toward it, slashes through the giant’s arm.

pages.ja: 捕まれた腕ごと遠坂は落下し、振り抜いた剣はガラスのように砕け散った。
pages.jaRuby: 捕まれた腕ごと遠坂は落下し、振り抜いた剣はガラスのように砕け散った。
pages.en: Tohsaka falls with the arm still gripping her, and the sword at the end of my swing shatters like glass.
pages.mirrorMoon: Tohsaka falls with the arm that was grabbing her, and the sword that cut through his arm shatters like glass.

pages.ja:
全身の血が逆流する。
だがそんなもの、なんの関心も持ち得ない。
剣は折れた。
それはあり得ない。あの剣を模造したのなら、砕ける筈などあり得ないのだ。
砕けたのは足りないからだ。
俺自身のイメージが、あの剣に及ばなかった。
pages.jaRuby:
全身の血が逆流する。

剣は折れた。

砕けたのは足りないからだ。

pages.en:
All the blood in my body surges backward.

But I cannot bring myself to care.

The sword broke.

That is impossible. If I had truly reproduced that sword, it could never have shattered.

It broke because something was missing.

The image within me did not measure up to the sword itself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
All the blood in me regurgitates.
But there’s no problem there.
The sword broke.
That is impossible. If I imitated that sword, it cannot be broken.
It broke because it was not sufficient.
My image of it fell short of the real sword.

pages.ja:
「」
向けられる眼光。
今度こそ俺を両断せんと、剛剣が振るわれる。
pages.jaRuby:
「」
向けられる眼光。
今度こそ俺を両断せんと、剛剣が振るわれる。
pages.en:
“————”

His glare fixes upon me.

The mighty blade swings again, this time to cut me in two.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
His eyes stare at me.
The giant sword is swung to really kill me this time.

pages.ja:
そんなコトはどうでもいい。
俺の相手はおまえじゃない。
衛宮士郎にとって、戦うべき相手はただ一人。
今のは完璧ではなかった。
砕けない筈の剣が砕けたのは想定に綻びがあった故。
複製するのなら形だけではなく、その制作者さえ再現する
！
pages.jaRuby:
そんなコトはどうでもいい。

今のは完璧ではなかった。
砕けない筈の剣が砕けたのは想定に綻びがあった故。

pages.en:
—None of that matters.

You are not the enemy I must fight.

Shirou Emiya has only one opponent.

The first sword was not perfect.

A blade that should never break was shattered because there was a flaw in my conception.

If I am to reproduce it, I must recreate not merely its shape, but even the one who made it—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I don’t care about that.
He’s not my opponent.
For Emiya Shirou, there is only one opponent.
The sword just now wasn’t perfect.
The unbreakable sword broke because there was a flaw in the assumptions.
If I am to duplicate it, I cannot only duplicate its shape… I must also reproduce the maker!

pages.ja:
「
」
まわりで息を呑む音がした。
目前では嵐のように振るわれる斧剣と、それを防ぎきる出来かけの剣が見えた。
無我夢中なのか、手にした剣で剣戟を合わせている。
そんな事は他人事だ。
今すべき事は、これを本物に仕上げるだけ。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」

無我夢中なのか、手にした剣で剣戟を合わせている。

pages.en:
“————”

I hear someone gasp nearby.

Before me, the axe-sword descends like a storm—and an unfinished sword wards it off completely.

Perhaps I am moving without thought, meeting blow after blow with the sword in my hands.

—But all of it feels as though it is happening to someone else.

All I must do now is finish this and make it real.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I hear a gasp.
In front of me is the axe-sword swung like a storm and a defending sword that is being made.
I don’t know if I’m desperate, but I’m blocking the attack with the sword in my hand.
But that’s none of my business.
What I need to do now is make this real.

それも間違いだ。
衛宮士郎は格闘には向かない。
おまえの戦いは精神の戦い、己との戦いでしかない』
pages.jaRuby:
『

おまえの戦いは精神の戦い、己との戦いでしかない』
pages.en:
“—That too is mistaken.

“Shirou Emiya is not suited to close combat.

“Your battle is a battle of the mind. It can only be a battle against yourself.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That is a mistake as well.
Emiya Shirou is not made for fighting.
Your fight is a mental fight, a fight with yourself.”

pages.ja:
言われなくても判っている。
やるべき事など単純だ。
「
投影、開始」
pages.jaRuby:

I know that without being told.

What I have to do is simple.

“—Projection, begin.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
I know that without being told.
What I must do is simple.
“Projection, start.”

pages.ja:
精神を引き絞る。
挑むべきは自分自身。ただ一つの狂いも妥協も許されない。
pages.jaRuby:
精神を引き絞る。
挑むべきは自分自身。ただ一つの狂いも妥協も許されない。
pages.en:
I draw my mind taut.

The only thing I must overcome is myself. I can permit not one error, not one compromise.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I concentrate.
I am challenging myself. No deviation or compromise is allowed.

pages.ja:
「ぎ
くう、う、あああ、あ
」
創造の理念を鑑定し、
基本となる骨子を想定し、
構成された材質を複製し、
制作に及ぶ技術を模倣し、
成長に至る経験に共感し、
蓄積された年月を再現し、
あらゆる工程を凌駕し尽くし
「く
あ、あああああああ…………！！！！」
ここに、幻想を結び剣と成す
！

pages.en:
“Gi—gh, aaah, ah—”

Appraise the concept of its creation.

Envision the structure at its core.

Reproduce the materials of its construction.

Imitate the skill of its making.

Share in the experience of its growth.

Recreate the years it has accumulated.

Surpass every process by which it came to be—

“Gh—aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah…!!!!”

Here, bind the illusion and make it a sword—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Gikuu, uh, aaaa, a”
Judging the concept of creation,
hypothesizing the basic structure,
duplicating the composition material,
imitating the skill of its making,
sympathizing with the experience of its growth,
reproducing the accumulated years,
excelling every manufacturing process
“Kuhah, ahhhhhhhhhhhh…!!!!”
Now, I bind the illusion and make it a sword!

pages.ja:
「
！」
巨人が吠える。
狂ったように叩きつけられる無数の剣風を、剣はことごとく防ぎきる……！
pages.jaRuby:
「
！」
巨人が吠える。
狂ったように叩きつけられる無数の剣風を、[ruby text=つるぎ]剣はことごとく防ぎきる……！
pages.en:
“————!”

The giant roars.

The sword turns aside every one of the countless blade-storms raining down in a frenzy…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
The giant howls.
The sword blocks the numerous blows smashing madly…!

pages.ja:
「っ…………！」
だがそこまでだ。
吹き飛ばされる。
意識が戻った途端、剣は全てを俺に委ねたのか。
今まで防ぎきっていた剣戟に、あっさりと弾き飛ばされた。
pages.jaRuby:
「っ…………！」
だがそこまでだ。
吹き飛ばされる。
意識が戻った途端、剣は全てを俺に委ねたのか。
今まで防ぎきっていた剣戟に、あっさりと弾き飛ばされた。
pages.en:
“Gh…………!”

But that is as far as it goes.

I am hurled away.

Did the sword entrust everything to me the instant my awareness returned?

The barrage it had warded off until now sweeps me aside with ease.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…!”
But this is it.
I’m tossed away.
As soon as my consciousness returns, the sword must have left everything in my hands.
I am easily thrown away by the attacks I was easily blocking until now.

pages.ja:
「は
あ」
腕の感覚などない。手首は赤くめくれ、まだ握れているのが不思議なほど。
pages.jaRuby:
「は
あ」
腕の感覚などない。手首は赤くめくれ、まだ握れているのが不思議なほど。
pages.en:
“Hah—ah.”

I cannot feel my arms. The skin of my wrists is peeled raw and red; it is a wonder my hands can still grip the sword.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haah”
The senses in my arms are already gone. My wrist is
about to rip off as I can see the red meat.
so red it’s amazing that it can still grasp.

pages.ja:
「っ
くっ…………！」
足腰も動かない。筋肉すべてが断線しているとしか思えない。
立ち上がれない。
ヤツを
バーサーカーを上回る剣は作った。
だがそれだけだ。
作るモノにすぎない自分には、せっかくの剣を使いこなす事が出来ない
！
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Gh—kh…………!”

My legs and hips will not move either. It feels as though every muscle in my body has been severed.

—I cannot stand.

I made a sword capable of surpassing him—of surpassing Berserker.

But that is all.

I am nothing more than the one who makes it. I cannot wield the magnificent sword I have created—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Kuh…!”
My legs won’t move. All my muscles must have stopped working.
I can’t stand up.
I made the sword that surpasses Berserker.
But that’s all.
As I am only a maker, I cannot handle the sword!

pages.ja:
影に覆われる。
今、誰を殺すべきか判っているのだろう。
弾き飛んだ俺を、バーサーカーは突風のように追撃し、
その剛剣を振り落とした。
pages.jaRuby:
影に覆われる。

弾き飛んだ俺を、バーサーカーは突風のように追撃し、
その剛剣を振り落とした。
pages.en:
A shadow engulfs me.

He must understand whom he needs to kill now.

Berserker pursues my flying body like a violent gust and brings his mighty sword down.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A shadow engulfs me.
He must know who he needs to kill first now.
Berserker pursues me like wind, and…
Swings his sword.

pages.ja:
弾かれる剛剣。
「え
？」
呆然とする俺の手には、誰かの手が添えられていた。
pages.jaRuby:
弾かれる剛剣。
「え
？」
呆然とする俺の手には、誰かの手が添えられていた。
pages.en:
The mighty blade is knocked aside.

“What—?”

As I stare in bewilderment, someone else's hand closes over mine.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But his sword is deflected.
“Eh?”
As I stand there in blank amazement, I notice another hand over my hand.

pages.ja:
「

pages.en:
—Wind passes through the clearing.

The bellow that shook the earth is gone. So are the blade-storms that cleaved the air.

“So that is your sword, Saber.”

The giant who could not be felled now stands without moving. He fixes his gaze upon the knight who defeated him and speaks in a heavy voice.

“This is Caliburn—the Golden Sword of Assured Victory. The sword in the stone that chose the king. My sword, lost forever.

“But—”

“That was not your sword. It was nothing more than an illusion fashioned by that man.”

Saber nods in silence.

“A counterfeit in the end. A sword that will never exist again.

“And yet—”

Berserker's chest splits open.

With a dry rasp, his body begins to crumble like gravel from the wound carved by the light.

“—Even that illusion cannot be dismissed. To think a single stroke would destroy this body seven times over.”

He invests the words of his destruction with no emotion.

Faithful to his role until the end, the mad warrior fades into the white air and scatters from existence.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Wind blows through the forest clearing.
Neither the howling that shook the ground nor the blows that cut the air remain now.
“So that is your sword, Saber.”
The undefeatable giant becomes motionless and says so in a deep voice, gazing at the knight that defeated him.
“This is Caliburn… the sword from the stone of selection. My sword that was forever lost.
But”
“That was not your sword. That was only an illusion made by this man.”
Saber nods quietly.
“It was an imitation after all. It is a sword that will never exist again.
But still”
Berserker’s chest splits open.
Slowly.
From the wound made by that light, he crumbles away like sand.
“That illusion cannot be underestimated. I did not expect it to destroy my body seven-fold with a single blow.”
He puts no emotion into his dying words.
The mad warrior follows his role until the very end, and his existence disperses as if fading into the air.

pages.en:
Dizziness washes over me.

I suppose it is the price of magecraft far beyond my limits. My blood has run wild, pressing against my brain and throwing it into a state of hyperoxia.

…And then there is the pain, as though my skull were being pried open.

The enemy is gone, and with him whatever had numbed me to it.

Dizziness and agony pour through me now, collecting every debt I have incurred.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I feel dizzy.
It must be the cost of using such excessive magic. My blood that ran wild is crushing my brain with too much oxygen.
…And on top of that, I have a headache like my head is splitting open.
It’s because the enemy has disappeared and the thing numbing my pain has disappeared.
The dizziness and the headache come at me as if to make up for what has accumulated.

The city is far away. None of my companions is unharmed, and there is scarcely an uninjured place among us.
